edbDesc: A phenomenon occurring in certain materials at low temperatures, characterised by the complete absence of magnetic permeability (i.e. a magnetic susceptibility ?v = -1) and the exclusion of the interior magnetic field. Superdiamagnetism is a feature of superconductivity.
title: Superdiamagnetism
pickWhy: Same as the Meissner effect: only in superconductors near absolute zero.
